gold: Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ (SCACPIS) arising in a precursor lesion of syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP) with macular amyloidosis

selector.rationale: Hidradenoma papilliferum best explains the clinical and histopathological findings, including the presence of a well-defined erythematous plaque with overlying ulceration and a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining and papillary projections.

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and presence of amyloid deposits not specific to this condition

rejected.label: Apocrine gland tumor
rejected.why: Less specific than Hidradenoma papilliferum and lacks distinctive features

rejected.label: Syringocystadenoma papilliferum
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and histopathology not typical for this condition
